_comment: Find Sound levels (Design Policy §J). Each id is BOTH a picture stem in assets/graphics/pools/soundpics/ and a clip stem (<id>.ogg) in the shared sound set. Add a level or extend an ids list freely — just keep a picture and a clip present for every id. `labels` overrides the spoken word (name-toggle, §E.3) for ids whose legacy filename reads oddly; anything not listed is de-slugged automatically.
